performance.cable-capacity-basis: front channel: Cat 6 24 AWG, 0.235 in (5.97 mm), at the 30% recommended fill of its 3.3 sq in usable area; 38 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Space-Saving Cable Management Rack Systems bulletin RKCB46, Cable Capacity Charts
performance.cable-capacity-rear-basis: rear channel: Cat 6 24 AWG, 0.235 in (5.97 mm), at the 30% recommended fill of its 4.1 sq in usable area; 47 at the 50% maximum fill - the same bulletin, which notes the rear section may be partially blocked by rack posts

physical.mounting-hardware: #12-24 mounting screws, as shipped with the covers

configs.description: The manager as Panduit ships NM1, both covers fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with both covers opened, the finger walls, the D-rings and the channels open to lay a cable in. The covers come with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: the specification sheet says the dual hinged covers open 110 degrees to the top or bottom without being removed; no view draws a hinge, and each cover is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of a cover's hinge

gaps.note: the plan view draws the five rear posts but no view draws the loop they belong to: the bars' thickness and the hook's extent are estimated, and so is the ring's opening, from the usable area the calculator states.
gaps.wanted: a side view or a section through the rear channel

gaps.note: the NM1B front-to-rear pass-through blanking panel is a separate accessory that closes the two windows; it is not drawn and the windows are open.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the blanking panel fitted

gaps.note: no view sections the covers or the fingers: their thickness is estimated and the elevations draw the body without the covers' edges.
gaps.wanted: a section through a cover and a finger tip
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the NM1 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP237); the temperatures are the customer drawing's.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger tips along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Charts of the Space-Saving bulletin (RKCB46) give the NM1 per cable at the 30 per cent recommended fill and the 50 per cent maximum, the front and the rear separately; the figures stated are the Cat 6 24 AWG 0.235 in (5.97 mm) column at 30 per cent: 22 front (38 at 50 per cent) and 28 rear (47). The Cable Capacity Calculator gives the usable areas, 3.3 and 4.1 sq in.

chassis.note: estimated - 444.83 x 44 x 332. The drawing dimensions 482 [19.0 in] over the ears, 465 [18.3 in] between the fixing holes, 44 [1.7 in] high and 332 [13.1 in] deep; the body between the ears is the NCMH2 drawing's 444.83 [17.51 in] for the same moulding, which this drawing does not give. The ears are not drawn.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the covers are drawn a shade lighter than the moulding.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The NM1 customer drawing (Panduit 10404-19) dimensions the front channel "5.5 REF [140]" from the front of the cover to the end of the finger zone and the whole manager "13.1 REF [332]"; the NMF1's "6.2 REF [157]" puts the plate and flange 17.3 behind the channel, and the rear channel is the 175 behind that. `at` is 139.7, so the ears bolt to the front face of the plate. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front with the cover fitted: the cover, and under it the two rows of T fingers end-on, the channel between them (24 high on the 44, estimated) and the two windows in the plate at the back of it, two stadiums 17 high.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the part is 332 deep with 139.7 of it in front of the rails and 192.3 behind them; it does not reach the rear rails of a rack 600 mm deep or more, so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: estimated - the front duct is the channel between the two finger rows, pitch 34.925 and gap 5.4 as on the NMF2; each rear ring's opening is the rear usable area Panduit's calculator gives (4.1 sq in) divided by the 24 clear height.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn; built from the plan view and the front view.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as the NM2's are (see nm2): the customer drawing (PDF 10404-19, with a DXF and a DWG that hold only a trimetric projection, so no measurement), the NetManager High Capacity specification sheet RKSP237, the product page, the Space-Saving bulletin RKCB46 and the Cable Capacity Calculator. THE FIGURES THE DRAWING DIMENSIONS ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURE (the finger and ring counts and pitch, the crossbar, the windows) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

rear.note: estimated - the rear channel from behind: the rear cover, and under it the five D-rings standing out of the plate's back, 107 apart with the middle one on the centre line. The plan view draws the five posts; their cross section is not drawn (see `gaps:`).

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX (see nm2): the plate on the front view as a well 139.7 deep with the finger walls and the cover in it; on the rear view the plate's back as a well 175 deep with the five D-rings and the rear cover in it; both floors open at the two windows.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the plan view, rear at y=0: the five posts 175 long, the plate and flange 17.3 deep, then the front channel's twelve stems 100 mm long with a crossbar on each tip.

weight.note: drawing - 816 g [1.8 lb], the weight table of the NM1 customer drawing (10404-19).
